posts.subject: Knife Server: Ranked Seasons
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey,


based on the idea from @BlackFire here: Ranks, I've thought about how we can make the concept work and I wanted to get feedback from you before announcing anything.


IMHO, it should work like this:

  • Reset all ranks (by putting rank points to 1000 but maintaining kills, deaths etc.) on the 01. April 2017
  • Start season 1 of the Knife Server rank tournament
  • Make the season last 4 months (until the 31. July 2017)
  • Reward the Top 100 players and start a new season

The seasons should last around 4 months, since it's the perfect balance of sustaining your position in the leaderboards and being active.
If the season length is 1-2 months, then it will annoy some of the players, because it's very frustrating to be reset that frequently. You'll keep losing your progress / work and if you're not a good player, that is very demotivating.
If the season length is around 6 months, then some of the players will achieve a high rank and then go back to being inactive until the last days of the season.
Having a season last for 4 months ensures 3 seasons per year, which is not too much nor too little.


Rewards could work like this:

  • Top 100: Chat-Tag like "KS1 ★ TOP 100", (KS = Knife Season) unique trail which says the same thing but with e.g. bronze text / colors
  • Top 5: Chat-Tag like "KS1 ☆ TOP 5", a unique silver trail and 5000 credits each
  • Top 1: Chat-Tag like "KS1 ✪ CHAMPION ✪", a unique golden trail and 10000 credits

Additionally, it should be announced in the chat that a season is currently running along with the end date of that season and that more information can be found by typing !season or !seasons in chat.
The commands !season or !seasons will lead the player to the forum thread with the announcement.


There should be no special rules during a season. However, admins need too pay attention to people trying to farm rank points. If a player is caught, please ban the player and inform @BlackFire or me, so we can reset that players points.


That should be it, I think. I hope I haven't forgotten anything, but if I did, please mention it along with your feedback on the system and ideas on how to maybe improve it further.


Thank you for reading this post.
